text_en: After Abimelech, Tola son of Puah son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, who lived at Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim, rose to deliver Israel.
text_cn: 阿彼默肋客之后，有依撒加尔人多多的孙子，普阿的儿子托拉起来拯救以色列。他住在厄弗辣因山地的沙米尔，

text_en: He judged Israel twenty-three years. Then he died, and was buried at Shamir.
text_cn: 作以色列民长有二十三年之久，死后葬在沙米尔。

text_en: After him came Jair the Gileadite, who judged Israel twenty-two years.
text_cn: 在他以后，有基肋阿得人雅依尔兴起，作以色列民长二十二年之久。

text_en: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkeys; and they had thirty towns, which are in the land of Gilead, and are called Havvoth-jair to this day.
text_cn: 他有三十个儿子，骑着三十匹驴驹；他们有三十座城，这些城称作哈沃特雅依尔，直到今日，都在基肋阿得地。

text_en: Jair died, and was buried in Kamon.
text_cn: 雅依尔死后埋葬在卡孟。

text_en: The Israelites again did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , worshiping the Baals and the Astartes, the gods of Aram, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the Ammonites, and the gods of the Philistines. Thus they abandoned the Lord , and did not worship him.
text_cn: 那时以色列子民又行了上主视为恶的事，事奉巴耳和阿市托勒特众神，以及阿兰的神，漆冬的神，摩阿布的神，阿孟子民的神，培肋舍特人的神；他们背弃上主，不事奉他。

text_en: So the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines and into the hand of the Ammonites,
text_cn: 上主向以色列发怒，把他们交在培肋舍特人和阿孟子民手中。

text_en: and they crushed and oppressed the Israelites that year. For eighteen years they oppressed all the Israelites that were beyond the Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.
text_cn: 从那一年起，他们迫害压制以色列子民，即所有住在约但河对岸，在阿摩黎人境内基肋阿得地方的以色列子民，一连十八年。

text_en: The Ammonites also crossed the Jordan to fight against Judah and against Benjamin and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was greatly distressed.
text_cn: 阿孟子民也过约但河来攻击犹大、本雅明和厄弗辣因家族；因此以色列很是困苦。

text_en: So the Israelites cried to the Lord , saying, “We have sinned against you, because we have abandoned our God and have worshiped the Baals. ”
text_cn: 以色列子民遂向上主呼吁说：“我们得罪了你，因为我们背弃了我们的天主，事奉了巴耳诸神！”

text_en: And the Lord said to the Israelites, “Did I not deliver you from the Egyptians and from the Amorites, from the Ammonites and from the Philistines?
text_cn: 上主对以色列子民说：“当埃及人、阿摩黎人、阿孟子民、培肋舍特人、

text_en: The Sidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, oppressed you; and you cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.
text_cn: 漆冬人、阿玛肋克人、米德杨人难为你们的时候，你们向我哀号，我岂没有从他们手中拯救了你们？

text_en: Yet you have abandoned me and worshiped other gods; therefore I will deliver you no more.
text_cn: 但是你们背弃了我，事奉了别的神，因此我不再拯救你们，

text_en: Go and cry to the gods whom you have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your distress. ”
text_cn: 去呼吁你们所选择的神吧！让他们在你们遭难时来拯救你们！”

text_en: And the Israelites said to the Lord , “We have sinned; do to us whatever seems good to you; but deliver us this day! ”
text_cn: 以色列子民对上主说：“我们犯了罪，你任意对待我们，只求你今日援救我们！”

text_en: So they put away the foreign gods from among them and worshiped the Lord ; and he could no longer bear to see Israel suffer.
text_cn: 以色列子民遂从他们中间除去外邦的神，而事奉上主；上主再不能容忍以色列受苦。

text_en: Then the Ammonites were called to arms, and they encamped in Gilead; and the Israelites came together, and they encamped at Mizpah.
text_cn: 那时阿孟子民集合在基肋阿得扎营，以色列子民也集合在米兹帕安营。

text_en: The commanders of the people of Gilead said to one another, “Who will begin the fight against the Ammonites? He shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead. ”
text_cn: 基肋阿得人民的首领彼此说：“谁开始攻打阿孟子民，谁就作全基肋阿得居民的首领。”
